description: Use this skill when a solopreneur or solo startup founder needs to choose, validate, or operate a business within one person's cash, time, and support capacity, including bootstrapped services, products, and AI-assisted businesses. Translate customer evidence into a bounded offer and a sustainable operating decision. Do not use for an isolated customer interview, financial calculation, growth analysis, or calendar triage; route those to the corresponding specialist.
